questions.passage: Now, when I go back to Japan, I have to consciously try not to smile. For example, I went to a fancy department store in Ginza, Tokyo, on one trip. I entered an elevator and looked at the others already in it. I noticed that their faces froze; they were scared of me.

A building site in an American suburb.
A fancy department store in Ginza, Tokyo.
His university friends' completed house in Japan.

美国郊区的一处建筑工地。
东京银座一家高档百货商店。
日本大学朋友已建好的房子。
analyses: A 车站属于前面的通勤研究，非本例地点。
B DIY 出现在上一文化例子，不是这次出行场景。
C fancy department store 与 Ginza, Tokyo 两项明确对应。
D 前文谈朋友是假设反应，这里没有参观朋友房屋的记录。

vocabulary.context: 此处修饰百货商店，不是动词想象或形容幻想中的。

options: A set of elevator-behaviour expectations as described by the author.
A requirement that the website user enter an actual elevator before continuing.
A new experiment that randomly assigns all Japanese residents to conditions.
A claim that the author has already obeyed every rule in this encounter.
optionsZh: 作者所描述的一组电梯行为规范。
要求网站使用者继续前先真的进入电梯。
将所有日本居民随机分组的新实验。
声称作者在此次相遇中已遵守每条规范。

C 没有随机分组研究；该故事是文化差异说明例。

questions.passage: Never look at anyone directly. No eye contact. You look down and don’t bother anyone. Leung and colleagues argue that experiences like this help us understand multiple meanings of the same form of behavior, which in turn helps us think of multiple uses for one tool or idea.
questions.prompt: How do Leung and colleagues connect cultural interpretation with creativity?
options: Recognizing multiple meanings may help generate multiple uses for a tool or idea.
Avoiding eye contact directly guarantees every invention.
Every behavior has only one correct meaning.

questions.promptZh: 研究者怎样联系文化解释与创造力？
optionsZh: 认识多种意义可能帮助想到工具或想法的多种用途。
不目光接触直接保证发明。
每种行为只有唯一含义。
文化解释阻止想到替代用途。
analyses: A multiple meanings...in turn...multiple uses 是所提出机制。
B 把电梯例直接当发明保证，跳过论证。
C 与 multiple 相反。

evidence.quote: understand multiple meanings of the same form of behavior, which in turn helps us think of multiple uses for one tool or idea.

questions.passage: A recent review of studies also shows that the benefits of multicultural experiences go beyond creativity. For example, time spent living abroad also helps individuals gain a clearer sense of who they are and the lives they want to pursue. questions.prompt: Which benefit beyond creativity is summarized in the review?

Complete elimination of all intergroup prejudice.
Greater self-clarity and more positive relations with others.
Less ability to understand people from other groups.

更清楚自我，与他人关系更积极。
更不能理解其他群体。
analyses: A clearer 是相对更清楚，非完美保证。
B fewer/less 是较少，不是零。
C 自我、信任、理解和较少偏见歧视都支持。
D better able 方向相反。这里是综述概述，不能凭该段断言所有底层研究皆随机因果。

trust others more and are better able to understand and relate to others.

questions.translation: 毕竟，按作者叙述，Steve Jobs 曾在几场产品发布会上对特定设备功能向观众说谎，也经常在 Whole Foods 的残障专用区停车。他显出道德相对主义迹象。但 Jobs 也有创造力。

evidence.quote: After all, Steve Jobs did lie to the audience about particular device functions in several product launches. He regularly parked his car in the handicapped section at Whole Foods. He showed signs of moral relativism. But Jobs was also creative.
